purpose: Teach: フィート/エアー/クロック/エリザベス/ミスター/ハワード/ルビー/パット

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが米国フィート単位の地図に苦戦された
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he struggled with American maps in feet.
lines.style: Soft, distant memory surfacing. Slow pace. Gentle nostalgia tinged with something unresolved. Eyes slightly unfocused, as if looking past the present moment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、エアー、つまりエアフォースの靴を初購入されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — you know, dear, when Grandpa was young, he bought those Air Force shoes for the first time, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm chuckle underneath. Redirecting gently, with affection. A small smile in the voice. Testing whether he remembers, too. Conversational and alive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアンティーククロックを蒐集された
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he collected antique clocks.
lines.style: Same distant quality as before. A pause before beginning, gathering the memory. Quieter than speech — almost murmuring. Trailing thoughtfully into the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、エリザベス女王の即位ニュースを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Dear, you watched the news about Queen Elizabeth's coronation when you were young, didn't you?
lines.style: Brighter now, nudging him with shared history. Light, knowing tone. A hint of 'I remember what you remember.' Not pushing, just gently insisting he was there too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがミスター・ロジャースのテレビを愛された
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he loved Mr. Rogers on television.
lines.style: Voice softening further. Almost a whisper. The memory tender now, not just distant. Small pause before speaking, as if honoring what he's saying.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、SF作家ハワードのご本を読まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You read those science fiction books by Howard when you were young, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Voice brightening with recognition. A knowing lift. Playful insistence — she's caught him in his own history. Warm and slightly teasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが私にルビーの指輪を贈られた
lines.en: Gran, when Father was young, he gave me a ruby ring.
lines.style: Deeper emotion now. Voice catches slightly. Slower, more deliberate. The weight of the gift settling in the words. A private moment spoken aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ゴルフでパット練習を毎週されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You practiced your putting every week on the golf course when you were young, remember, dear?
lines.style: Close and intimate, almost a whisper of shared warmth. A final gentle assertion of what they both know. Fading slightly at the end, as if settling into memory together.
